one_line: Promise a better way in the first line, then give three labelled ideas, each naming the skill it builds.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman sits on the floor holding two toy boxes to the camera, smiling; a clip mic on her top. Text and voice: "יש לשחק עם הילד ויש לשחק עם הילד...", then pink script "כמו קלינאית תקשורת" at 0:02.
q1_hook.why: A promise to show how a professional plays, spoken and written in the first second by a smiling person (H1, H4, H6), opens a gap that the three ideas fill (H5). Her role is on screen at 0:02 (T3), and the product is in her hands (S1). The pink script covers the boxes (T4).

beats.what: She holds two boxes to the camera; "יש לשחק עם הילד ויש לשחק עם הילד... כמו קלינאית תקשורת"
beats.why: Expert promise with a face and voice

beats.what: Hands pour pink sand into a tray and press it flat; she names three ideas (transcript)
beats.why: Shows the material, 10 s before the first idea

beats.what: Idea 1: a sand playground with swings and a slide; title "גן שעשועים", location words
beats.why: First of three, the skill named on screen

beats.what: Idea 2: a blue sand beach with dolls and shells; title "חוף הים", verbs
beats.why: A new scene, a different word type

beats.what: Idea 3: white snow with penguins and an ice tray; title "שלג קינטי", adjectives
beats.why: The third scene completes the list

beats.what: Back on the floor with the finished scenes; "יש המון דרכים לשחק בחול קינטי"
Two boxes over a fake social bar; "לעוד טיפים והמלצות המשיכו לעקוב"

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at 0:39: a follow prompt. Caption: a how-to question first, then "לקישור לחול קינטי כתבו פה". The list is worth saving, but there is no save ask.
q2_flow.why: The promise opens a loop that three labelled ideas close, with a new scene every 4 to 7 s (H5, R3), and the skill-by-scene list is reusable (R7). The 10 s of sand preparation before the first idea is the slow stretch (R1).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:39-0:41 (grey box, pink text): "לעוד טיפים והמלצות המשיכו לעקוב". Caption: "המשיכו לעקוב 🧩" and "לקישור לחול קינטי כתבו פה 👇🏼". Not spoken.
q3_cta.why: Two different asks, follow in the video and a link by comment in the caption (C1). "כתבו פה" names no keyword (C3), and it is only in the caption, not said or shown in the video (C6). The end card is a generic follow prompt.

q4_shown.what: The presenter and two boxes 0:00 and 0:32; sand poured and pressed 0:05-0:15; three scenes with figures, a playground, a beach with dolls and shells, snow with penguins and a snowball tool, 0:16-0:31; the two boxes standing on the floor 0:39. No child, no price.
q4_shown.why: An SLP voice is the proof (S6), carried by hands-only demos (S4). The product is in hand at 0:00 and in use at 0:05 (S1). No child's face appears (S5). No disclosure words appear (S7).

q5_edit.what: 6 shots in 41.4 s, about 7 s each: talking head, one 15.7 s sand-and-playground shot, then locked-off scenes of 5 to 7 s, talking head, end card. Subtitles and coloured title cards. Speech throughout; ends on a 2.6 s end card.
q5_edit.why: A cut or new scene every 4 to 7 s keeps the pace moderate (R3). The long locked-off holds suit a calm demo but have little change (E2). Subtitles and cards double the speech (E4). It ends on a follow card, not a payoff (E8).

q6_topic.what: How to turn a kinetic sand toy into a language game: three scenes, each practising a word type. An expert tip for parents of toddlers and preschoolers.
q6_topic.why: A child's language development is a real concern, and each tip is specific and checkable (K6, K4). It is calm information with expert warmth, but no child moment or laugh wraps it (K1). A parent can save the list (R7).

q7_filmed.what: Static, tripod-looking frames: an eye-level medium shot of her seated on the floor against a white wall, a lavalier mic visible, soft daylight; high-angle medium shots of hands and a tray on a grey floor; a straight-on shot of two boxes.
q7_filmed.why: She looks and speaks to the lens, which suits a tip (F6). Even light and steady frames look clean, though planned rather than homemade (F7). The boxes are large and readable (F4). The pink script title sits over them in the bottom third (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles with a dark edge, about 70% down: "יש לשחק עם הילד ויש לשחק עם הילד..." (0:00); pink script "כמו קלינאית תקשורת" (0:02); scene titles in colour near the top, "גן שעשועים" (0:16), "חוף הים" (0:20), "שלג קינטי" (0:30), each with 3 to 4 small lines ("ומתרגלים מילות יחס כמו:") and a word list in a handwriting font; end card "לעוד טיפים והמלצות המשיכו לעקוב".
q8_text.caption: "איך הופכים משחק תחושתי בחול קינטי לחוויה שמפתחת שפה?". About 55 words: a how-to question, a short explanation, a follow ask, "לקישור לחול קינטי כתבו פה". No hashtags, no disclosure words.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second states the topic (T3). The scene cards carry several lines near the demo, and the word lists in a handwriting font are hard to read (T2, T5). The pink script sits in the bottom 35% (T4). The caption opens with the search question (T7); only the coauthor discloses (T8).

weak_points: Text-heavy cards over the demo and word lists in a hard-to-read font; a pink title over the boxes in the bottom third; no result shown; a link ask with no keyword; disclosure by coauthor only; a follow-only end card.
lumebook_takeaway: Film three locked-off top-down page spreads, each with a one-line label of the skill it builds, no child; open with a text promise, close with one ask.
not_verified: The exact spoken hook (the transcript is garbled with a gap from 0:16 to 0:30). The word lists in the handwriting font are only partly legible at 0:18, 0:24 and 0:29. The sponsor terms with the coauthor. Music is not evident. Correction to src/coded: the sand preparation and the playground are one shot (the cut is at 20.3 s), and the caption says "כתבו פה" without a comment word.
